blocks.title: Правило 1: Present Simple для привычек
paragraphs: Present Simple нужен, когда действие повторяется регулярно: every day, usually, often, sometimes. С he/she/it добавляем -s. В вопросах и отрицаниях используем do/does.
rules: He/she/it + verb-s: She lives in Boston.
Does забирает -s на себя: Does she live here?
После don't/doesn't глагол без -s: He doesn't speak Spanish.
formulas: I work · She works · Do you work? · Does she work? · She doesn't work

tasks.prompt: Выберите: She ___ in a cafe.

tasks.prompt: Выберите: He ___ English at work.
tasks.explanation: В отрицании с he используем doesn't + глагол без -s.

blocks.title: Правило 2: Past Simple для завершенного прошлого
paragraphs: Past Simple используем, когда действие закончилось и есть прошлое время: yesterday, last week, in 2024, two days ago.
rules: Правильные глаголы получают -ed: visited, watched.
Неправильные нужно учить: go - went, buy - bought.
После did/didn't глагол в начальной форме.
formulas: I visited · I went · Did you go? · I didn't go

tasks.prompt: Впишите: I ___ to the cinema yesterday. (go)
tasks.explanation: Yesterday показывает Past Simple; go превращается в went.

tasks.prompt: Выберите: Did you ___ to school yesterday?
tasks.explanation: После did основной глагол возвращается в начальную форму.

blocks.title: Правило 1: Present Simple и Present Continuous
paragraphs: Present Simple нужен для привычек, фактов, расписаний и регулярных действий. Present Continuous нужен для действия сейчас или временной ситуации.
rules: Usually, often, sometimes, every day часто требуют Present Simple.
Now, right now, at the moment, today, this week часто требуют Present Continuous.
С расписаниями транспорта часто используем Present Simple: The plane leaves at 7.
В вопросах Present Simple нужен do/does: Do you travel often? Does she need a visa?
formulas: I usually travel with one suitcase. · Today I am carrying two bags. · The flight leaves at 9:30.

Памятка: 
Present Simple = verb / verb+s (for he, she, it)
Present Continuous = am/is/are + verb + ing
Examples: I usually travel by plane. · I am checking in now. · The flight leaves at 9:30.

blocks.title: Ответы на вопросы с прошлого занятия
paragraphs: Разбираем слова через значение, произношение и понятную схему.

Короткие гласные: /ɪ/ - короткое “и”, пример sit ; /e/ - “э”, пример bed ; /æ/ - широкий звук между “э” и “а”, пример cat ; /ʌ/ - короткое “а”, но глубже, пример cup ; /ʊ/ - короткое “у”, пример book ; /ə/ - очень слабое безударное “э/а”, почти проглатывается, пример about .

Долгие гласные: /iː/ - длинное “ии”, пример see ; /ɑː/ - длинное открытое “а”, пример car ; /ɔː/ - длинное “о”, пример door ; /uː/ - длинное “уу”, пример blue ; /ɜː/ - длинное “ё/э” без точной русской пары, пример turn .

Дифтонги: /eɪ/ - “эй”, пример day ; /aɪ/ - “ай”, пример line ; /ɔɪ/ - “ой”, пример boy ; /aʊ/ - “ау”, пример now ; /əʊ/ BrE или /oʊ/ AmE - “оу”, пример go ; /eə/ - “эа”, пример chair ; /ɪə/ - “иэ/иа”, пример near ; /ʊə/ - “уэ/уа”, пример tour .

Понятные согласные: /p/ - “п”, пример pen ; /b/ - “б”, пример bag ; /t/ - “т”, пример tea ; /d/ - “д”, пример day ; /k/ - “к”, пример key ; /g/ - “г”, пример go ; /f/ - “ф”, пример five ; /v/ - “в”, пример very ; /s/ - “с”, пример see ; /z/ - “з”, пример zoo ; /m/ - “м”, пример man ; /n/ - “н”, пример name ; /l/ - “л”, пример line ; /h/ - легкое “х”, пример hotel ; /r/ - английское “р”, не раскатываем, пример room ; /w/ - губной звук между “у” и “в”, пример we ; /j/ - “й”, пример yes .

blocks.title: Полезные фразы: приветствие
paragraphs: Слова для пропусков: meet you · no see · to see you · by the way · are you · these days
rules: Long time no see! - Сколько лет, сколько зим! Так говорят тому, кого давно не видели.
How are you? - стандартный вопрос при встрече со знакомым.
Great to see you! - о знакомом. Nice to meet you - только о новом человеке, при первом знакомстве.
Where are you living these days? - these days значит «сейчас, в последнее время».
My name's Mark, by the way. - by the way («кстати») помогает представиться посреди разговора.

rules: What a + прилагательное + существительное! - What a lovely surprise!
How + прилагательное! - How nice!
That's + прилагательное + news. - That's fantastic news.
That sounds + прилагательное. - That sounds good.

tasks.prompt: Прочитайте текст выше и выберите ответ: What do people in Britain and the USA usually talk about first?
tasks.explanation: В тексте: it is normal to start with the situation you are in - погода, еда, музыка.
tasks.text: Small talk is the short, friendly conversation people have before a meeting, at a party or while they are waiting for a train. In Britain and the USA it is normal to start with the situation you are in: the weather, the food or the music. Then you can ask a simple question about the other person: Where are you living these days? What do you do? Good listeners do not only ask questions. They also show interest with short phrases like How nice! or That sounds great, so the other person knows they are listening. Personal questions about money, age or religion are a bad idea with somebody you have just met. When you want to leave, do not just walk away. Say I really must go and then It was nice to meet you.

blocks.title: Аудирование: Nina и Chris о связи с близкими
paragraphs: Послушайте разговор и ответьте на вопросы по-английски. Транскрипция ниже - откройте её только после проверки.
blocks.transcript: Chris: So, are you good about keeping in touch with people? Nina: Er, not really. I always plan to write to people, but then I forget. I send emails to my parents sometimes, about once a month, but more often I get emails from them saying, 'Are you OK? We haven't heard from you for a long time.' Then I always send them a quick email and tell them what I'm doing. How about you? Chris: Oh, I like keeping in touch. I think it's important to keep in touch with your family. I write emails to my parents sometimes, but I also phone or Skype. I phone my mother every weekend. Nina: Every weekend! Chris: Yes, she gets worried about me and she wants to know what I'm doing. Nina: I hardly ever phone my parents. I wait until I go and see them and talk to them then. Chris: Don't you ever phone them to have a chat? Nina: No, I only phone if it's something important. You don't have to be in touch with people all the time. Chris: What about friends? Surely you keep in touch with friends? Nina: Not very much; maybe I should do. I send texts or messages sometimes, but that's about all. I always think if you have good friends, you can talk about everything when you meet. It's more fun to tell people your news when you can have a real conversation. Chris: Oh well, I often send messages to people so they know I'm thinking about them. And sometimes, when I have a particularly good photo, I send it to everyone by email.

paragraphs: Simon учится в Саламанке и пишет трём людям: другу Блейку (они учатся в одном колледже, сейчас Блейк на каникулах в Германии), дяде и тёте (им он пишет сразу обоим) и младшей сестре Мике (летом она подрабатывает). Имён в письмах нет — определите адресата по подсказкам в тексте, затем ответьте на остальные вопросы.
blocks.text:
Письмо 1
Hope you're both well and are enjoying the summer. I'm in Salamanca, in Spain. This is a photo I took of the old centre. It's a beautiful old city, as you can see - and really big! It has an incredible mix of old, historical places and new, trendy areas. As you know, I'm learning Spanish at the moment. I'm taking a two-month Spanish course here, so my Spanish is slowly improving. The classes are very good, and we also watch Spanish films. It's pretty hot here, but it's nice and cool in the evenings. Love to all, Simon

Письмо 2
How's it going? Are you having a good time in Berlin? Here are some photos of my group on the Spanish course. We're all from different countries, so we usually speak English when we're together - not very good for my Spanish! Anyway, I'm having a great time here, and the time's going much too quickly. There are a lot of good cafes here, and we usually all go out at night together. What's Berlin like? Send me some photos! See you back at college next month. Simon

Письмо 3
I'm sending you some photos of the family I'm staying with in Salamanca. They've got a daughter the same age as you (her name's Blanca). She speaks English quite well, but we usually speak Spanish together. She introduced me to some of her friends, and I speak Spanish with them, too ... some of the time, not always! How's your job in the supermarket? Hope you're not working too hard and are saving a lot of money! See you next week. Love, Simon xx

rules: Грамматика: Present Continuous = be + verb-ing. I having a great time → I'm having a great time.
Орфография: fotos → photos, corse → course, diferent → different, countrys → countries (слово на -y во множественном числе даёт -ies).
Пунктуация: на месте пропущенной буквы ставим апостроф. youre → you're, im → I'm.
Заглавные буквы: имена, страны и города пишутся с большой буквы. spain → Spain, spanish → Spanish.

tasks.prompt: Прочитайте текст выше и выберите ответ: What is the problem with short messages?
tasks.explanation: В тексте: Short messages are quick and easy, but they say very little.
tasks.text: People keep in touch in very different ways. Some send a message every day, others write a long email once a month. Short messages are quick and easy, but they say very little: 'How are you?' - 'Fine, you?' A phone call takes more time, and that is why many people like it: you hear the voice and you can have a real chat. Photos work well too, because one picture can show a new city, a new flat or a new haircut without any words. Some people hardly ever write first, but they always answer. That doesn't mean they don't care - they simply prefer to talk when they meet. The important thing is to find a way that works for both of you, and to say sorry when you disappear for a few weeks.

blocks.title: Чтение: Yes Man changed my life
paragraphs: Ричард прочитал книгу Дэнни Уоллеса и решил неделю отвечать «да» на любой вопрос. Прочитайте, что из этого вышло.
blocks.text:
Yes Man is the best book I've ever read. It's the true story of a year in the life of author Danny Wallace. Before Danny Wallace became the 'Yes Man', his life was boring and he felt old. So he decided to make things more exciting. He started saying 'yes' to every question people asked him. And he did it for a whole year. From the day he started, it completely changed his life, and he had all kinds of adventures. It's a fantastic story. When I finished the book, I wanted to change my life like Danny Wallace. So I took a holiday from work and became a 'Yes Man' for a week. This is what happened.

DAY 1. I started on Saturday morning. At 10 am, I got my first question. I saw a poster in the window of a travel agent's. It said, 'Tired?' (Yes - I slept badly the night before, so I was tired.) Under this, it said, 'Do you need a holiday?' (Yes, definitely.) So I went in. The travel agent asked me where I wanted to go. But before I could answer, she said, 'Somewhere hot?' I don't like hot weather, but I said, 'Yes.' 'A beach holiday? Maybe in Greece?' I don't like the beach. I prefer cities. But I said, 'Yes.' 'What kind of accommodation? A hotel? Or a ...' I hate hotels, but before she could continue, I said, 'Yes.' Five minutes later, everything was ready. My flight was the next day.

DAY 2. I arrived at my hotel on the island of Zante at lunchtime. It was very, very hot. I just wanted to check in and unpack my suitcase, but the receptionist said, 'We have a minibus to the beach in ten minutes. Do you want to go?' You know the answer I gave her. It was about 40C at the beach. Luckily, I brought suntan lotion. A man came towards me: 'Sunglasses? Do you want sunglasses?' I had some in my bag, but I said, 'Yes.' Five minutes later, another man came: 'Beautiful hat, sir?' I tried not to look at him. Three hours later, I had two pairs of sunglasses, three hats, a watch and a woman's necklace. It was difficult to carry all my new things back to the minibus. I decided: no trips tomorrow, just rest. When I got back, the receptionist asked, 'Did you like the beach?' I didn't, but I said, 'Yes.' 'Oh, there's a water skiing course tomorrow. Do you want me to book a place for you?' I can't swim very well, and I don't like the sea. I wanted to cry ...

blocks.title: Правило 1: Past Continuous — что происходило в тот момент
paragraphs: Past Simple говорит, что случилось. Past Continuous рисует картину вокруг: что уже происходило в тот момент. Именно так начинаются хорошие истории о поездках.
rules: Форма: was / were + глагол с -ing. I / he / she / it was sitting · you / we / they were sitting.
Действие в процессе в конкретный момент прошлого: At 10 am I was standing in front of a travel agent's.
Фон истории: It was very hot, the sun was shining and people were swimming in the sea.
Отрицание и вопрос: I wasn't listening. · What were you doing at midnight? · Was she waiting for you?
Глаголы состояния (like, love, know, want, need, have в значении «иметь») в Continuous не ставим: I didn't like the beach, а не I wasn't liking.
formulas: was / were + verb-ing: The receptionist was smiling. · wasn't / weren't + verb-ing: We weren't sleeping. · Was / Were + подлежащее + verb-ing? Were they waiting?

blocks.transcript: Day 3. Richard: So, the next morning, we started with some water skiing practice on the beach. First, they showed us how to stand up on the skis and then how to fall off safely. The lesson took about an hour, and then we were ready to go out to sea. There were five other people in my group, who were all very excited. But not me - I was really worried. The instructor looked at me and said, 'Do you want to go first?' and then everyone looked at me. I felt sick but I said, 'Yes'. Ten seconds after I started, I fell over. I tried again. And I fell over again. Then the third time, something amazing suddenly happened. I didn't fall over. And I found out that I love water skiing. The ten minutes in the water passed very quickly and I didn't want to stop! When we got back to the hotel, the receptionist asked me, 'So, did you enjoy the water skiing course?' I said, 'Yes' which, for the first time, was the truth. And then later on that evening I had a drink in the bar with the other water skiers.

blocks.title: Правило 2: when и while — прерванное действие
paragraphs: Когда длинное действие прерывается коротким, длинное ставим в Past Continuous, а короткое - в Past Simple. Прослушайте примеры из учебника.
rules: Длинное действие (Past Continuous) + короткое, которое его прервало (Past Simple): I was lying on the beach when a man came towards me.
Два длинных действия одновременно - оба в Past Continuous: While Richard was skiing, his friends were watching from the boat.
Цепочка коротких действий одно за другим - только Past Simple: He stood up, fell over and tried again.
Если часть с when / while стоит первой, после неё ставим запятую: While we were waiting, it started to rain.
during + существительное, while + подлежащее и глагол: during the flight, но while we were flying.
formulas:
Чем отличаются when и while

while — «пока, в то время как». Ставится перед ДЛИННЫМ действием в Past Continuous:
    While I was swimming, a mosquito bit me.

when — «когда, в тот момент». Обычно ставится перед КОРОТКИМ действием в Past Simple:
    I was swimming when a mosquito bit me.

Это одна и та же ситуация, просто с разных сторон: while показывает, что длилось, when — что в этот момент случилось.
Подсказка: while ≈ «пока длилось», when ≈ «в тот момент, когда».

Когда подходит только одно из двух

• Два длинных действия одновременно — while: While I was cooking, my sister was setting the table.
• Одно действие сразу после другого — только when, оба глагола в Past Simple: When I got to the hotel, I called my mum.
• Перед коротким действием while не ставят: I was reading when the phone rang, но не «… while the phone rang».
• Перед длинным действием when тоже можно: When I was swimming, a mosquito bit me — это не ошибка.

blocks.title: Произношение: слабые и сильные формы was и were
paragraphs: В быстрой речи was и were почти проглатываются, а в кратких ответах и отрицаниях звучат полностью. Прослушайте запись и повторите за диктором.
rules: В утверждении и в начале вопроса - слабая форма: was /wəz/, were /wə/. I was /wəz/ driving to work. Were /wə/ they travelling by train?
В кратком ответе, в конце фразы - сильная форма: Yes, she was /wɒz/. Yes, they were /wɜː/.
Отрицания всегда звучат полностью и с ударением: wasn't /ˈwɒznt/, weren't /wɜːnt/.
Главное ударение в Past Continuous падает на смысловой глагол: I was DRIving to work. We weren't WATCHing.

blocks.transcript: Day Seven. Richard: On the last day of the holiday, I couldn't wait for midnight. At 12 o'clock, I could stop answering 'yes' to every question. The week had been fun, but I wanted some control of my life again! That evening, I went for one last dinner with some of my new friends. 'So, did you have a good week?' one of them asked me. 'Yes,' I said. 'What was your favourite thing?' she asked. And do you know what? I couldn't really answer her. There were so many things I had enjoyed. I worked as a waiter for a day - I didn't get any money for it, but I made friends with some interesting people who came to eat at the restaurant. I also spent a day fishing with five Greek fishermen and caught several fish. I stayed at a beach party until six in the morning. Oh, and I won a dancing competition! Of course, some of my experiences weren't very good. I took the same boat trip three times. I went swimming at midnight - actually, I liked the swimming, but I didn't like the mosquitoes that bit me when I got out of the sea. And I spent over 200 euros on souvenirs that I hate! It was great to try new things. But I was glad the week was nearly finished.

blocks.sample: Two years ago I went to Georgia with my sister. We stayed in a small guest house in Tbilisi - the family cooked breakfast for us every morning. I remember our first evening very well: it was warm, the sun was going down and people were sitting in cafes along the river. One thing went wrong: we were walking to the station when my sister realised she didn't have her passport. We ran back to the guest house and missed our train to Batumi, so we took an expensive taxi. While we were driving, the driver was telling us stories about his village - it was the best part of the day. I brought back some wine and a small carpet.

questions.explanation: Тема: present simple. Правильный вариант — «goes».

questions.explanation: Тема: present simple. Правильный вариант — «does».

questions.explanation: Тема: present simple negative. Правильный вариант — «don't eat».

questions.explanation: Тема: past simple. Правильный вариант — «send».

questions.explanation: Тема: past negative. Правильный вариант — «didn't attend».

questions.explanation: Тема: present perfect. Правильный вариант — «yet».

questions.explanation: Тема: past/perfect contrast. Правильный вариант — «visited».

questions.text: Выберите план: We ___ visit our friends tomorrow. We have tickets.
questions.explanation: Тема: future. Правильный вариант — «are going to».

questions.text: Выберите спонтанное решение: It's cold. I ___ close the window.
questions.explanation: Тема: future. Правильный вариант — «will».

questions.explanation: Тема: modals. Правильный вариант — «should».

questions.text: Выберите запрет: You ___ park here.
questions.explanation: Тема: modals. Правильный вариант — «mustn't».

questions.text: Выберите сравнительную степень: This test is ___ than the last one.
questions.explanation: Тема: comparatives. Правильный вариант — «easier».

questions.text: Выберите превосходную степень: This is ___ restaurant in the area.
questions.explanation: Тема: superlatives. Правильный вариант — «the best».

questions.text: Выберите слово: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: Тема: quantity. Правильный вариант — «any».

questions.explanation: Тема: quantity. Правильный вариант — «much».

questions.text: Выберите артикль: I saw ___ interesting film yesterday.
questions.explanation: Тема: articles. Правильный вариант — «an».

questions.text: Выберите предлог: I usually go to work ___ 9 o'clock.
questions.explanation: Тема: prepositions. Правильный вариант — «at».

questions.text: Выберите предлог: My birthday is ___ May.
questions.explanation: Тема: prepositions. Правильный вариант — «in».

questions.text: Выберите вежливую просьбу: ___ you help me, please?
questions.explanation: Тема: functions. Правильный вариант — «Could».

questions.explanation: Тема: vocabulary. Правильный вариант — «book».

questions.explanation: Тема: vocabulary. Правильный вариант — «doctor».
